name: Legal and compliance
description: Industry vocabulary only. Not legal advice.

hasDefinedTerm.name: indemnity
hasDefinedTerm.description: A promise by one party to cover specified losses suffered by another.

hasDefinedTerm.name: limitation of liability
hasDefinedTerm.description: A clause capping what one party can owe the other if things go wrong.

hasDefinedTerm.name: force majeure
hasDefinedTerm.description: A clause excusing performance when specified extraordinary events prevent it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: warranty
hasDefinedTerm.description: A contractual promise that a stated fact is true, with remedies if it is not.

hasDefinedTerm.name: representation
hasDefinedTerm.description: A statement of fact made to induce another party to enter an agreement.

hasDefinedTerm.name: covenant
hasDefinedTerm.description: A contractual promise to do or refrain from doing something.

hasDefinedTerm.name: consideration
hasDefinedTerm.description: The thing of value each side gives, without which a contract is generally unenforceable.

hasDefinedTerm.name: term and termination
hasDefinedTerm.description: The clauses setting how long an agreement runs and how it can be ended.

hasDefinedTerm.name: assignment
hasDefinedTerm.description: Transferring contractual rights or obligations to a third party.

hasDefinedTerm.name: governing law
hasDefinedTerm.description: The jurisdiction whose law will be used to interpret an agreement.

hasDefinedTerm.name: arbitration
hasDefinedTerm.description: Private dispute resolution before a neutral decision-maker instead of a court.

hasDefinedTerm.name: NDA
hasDefinedTerm.description: An agreement restricting disclosure of information shared between parties.

hasDefinedTerm.name: MSA
hasDefinedTerm.description: An umbrella contract setting standing terms, with specific work defined in separate orders.

hasDefinedTerm.name: SOW
hasDefinedTerm.description: A document defining scope, deliverables, and timelines under a master agreement.

hasDefinedTerm.name: DPA
hasDefinedTerm.description: A contract governing how a vendor handles personal data on a customer's behalf.

hasDefinedTerm.name: SLA
hasDefinedTerm.description: A commitment to defined service standards, usually with remedies for shortfalls.

hasDefinedTerm.name: boilerplate
hasDefinedTerm.description: Standard clauses appearing in most agreements. Routine, and occasionally consequential.

hasDefinedTerm.name: redline
hasDefinedTerm.description: A marked-up draft showing proposed changes between negotiating parties.

hasDefinedTerm.name: execution
hasDefinedTerm.description: The signing that makes an agreement binding.

hasDefinedTerm.name: LLC
hasDefinedTerm.description: Limited liability company. A US structure combining liability protection with pass-through taxation.

hasDefinedTerm.name: incorporation
hasDefinedTerm.description: Forming a company as a legal entity separate from its owners.

hasDefinedTerm.name: registered agent
hasDefinedTerm.description: The party designated to receive legal notices on a company's behalf.

hasDefinedTerm.name: due diligence
hasDefinedTerm.description: Investigation of a counterparty or asset before committing to a transaction.

hasDefinedTerm.name: litigation
hasDefinedTerm.description: Resolving a dispute through the courts.

hasDefinedTerm.name: discovery
hasDefinedTerm.description: The pre-trial phase in which parties exchange relevant evidence.

hasDefinedTerm.name: deposition
hasDefinedTerm.description: Sworn out-of-court testimony taken during discovery.

hasDefinedTerm.name: settlement
hasDefinedTerm.description: An agreed resolution ending a dispute without a judgment.

hasDefinedTerm.name: injunction
hasDefinedTerm.description: A court order requiring a party to do or stop doing something.

hasDefinedTerm.name: statute of limitations
hasDefinedTerm.description: The deadline after which a claim can no longer be brought.

hasDefinedTerm.name: class action
hasDefinedTerm.description: A suit brought by representatives on behalf of a larger group with common claims.

hasDefinedTerm.name: privilege
hasDefinedTerm.description: Protection from compelled disclosure of confidential legal advice.

hasDefinedTerm.name: conflict of interest
hasDefinedTerm.description: A situation where duties to one client could compromise duties to another.

hasDefinedTerm.name: retainer
hasDefinedTerm.description: An advance payment securing legal services.

hasDefinedTerm.name: billable hour
hasDefinedTerm.description: The standard unit of legal billing. Increasingly supplemented by fixed-fee arrangements.

hasDefinedTerm.name: intellectual property
hasDefinedTerm.description: Legally protected creations: patents, trademarks, copyrights, and trade secrets.

hasDefinedTerm.name: trademark
hasDefinedTerm.description: A protected mark identifying the source of goods or services.

hasDefinedTerm.name: copyright
hasDefinedTerm.description: Protection for original works of authorship, arising automatically on creation.

hasDefinedTerm.name: patent
hasDefinedTerm.description: A time-limited exclusive right over an invention, granted in exchange for disclosure.

hasDefinedTerm.name: trade secret
hasDefinedTerm.description: Commercially valuable information protected by being kept confidential.

hasDefinedTerm.name: fair use
hasDefinedTerm.description: A US doctrine permitting some unlicensed use of copyrighted work. Fact-specific and decided case by case.

hasDefinedTerm.name: licence
hasDefinedTerm.description: Permission to use protected material on stated terms.

hasDefinedTerm.name: GDPR
hasDefinedTerm.description: The EU regulation governing personal data processing, with extraterritorial reach.

hasDefinedTerm.name: CCPA
hasDefinedTerm.description: California's consumer privacy law, granting access, deletion, and opt-out rights.

hasDefinedTerm.name: data subject request
hasDefinedTerm.description: An individual's request to access, correct, or delete data held about them.

hasDefinedTerm.name: processor
hasDefinedTerm.description: A party handling personal data on behalf of, and under instruction from, a controller.

hasDefinedTerm.name: controller
hasDefinedTerm.description: The party determining the purposes and means of processing personal data.

hasDefinedTerm.name: breach notification
hasDefinedTerm.description: The regulated obligation to inform authorities and affected people after a data breach.

hasDefinedTerm.name: records retention
hasDefinedTerm.description: The policy governing how long records are kept and when they are destroyed.

hasDefinedTerm.name: legal hold
hasDefinedTerm.description: A directive suspending routine deletion when litigation is anticipated.

hasDefinedTerm.name: compliance program
hasDefinedTerm.description: The structured set of policies, training, and monitoring used to meet legal obligations.
